_doc: Landmarks of the Season 7 reference shots (pixels in the original files) for hair_match.py: eye line and chin bottom; the front's face centre and its width at the eye line (temple to temple under the hair); the sides' nose tip. 'cut': rows from here down are clothing, not hair. our_face_width: our head's width at the eye line (m). Sides: eye, nose tip and chin as (x, y) points — fitted to ours with a similarity (scale, rotation, shift), so a head pitched in the shot is turned back level.
